summary: Completed testing of Invoice Generator app at /tools/invoice. Backend API (15/15 tests passed) and frontend UI (all components working). Found 1 bug: login page ignores redirect parameter.

ui_bugs.issue: Login page ignores redirect query parameter - always redirects to /account instead of the requested URL
ui_bugs.details: When user visits /tools/invoice without auth, they are correctly redirected to /login?redirect=/tools/invoice. However, after successful login, the page always redirects to /account instead of using the redirect parameter.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice Generator app at /tools/invoice is fully functional. Backend API tests in /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_api.py cover all CRUD operations for invoices and clients. Frontend has 3-column layout: sidebar (navigation + actions), editor (form sections), preview panel (live preview + PDF/Print). One bug to fix: login redirect parameter not being used. After fix, user should be redirected back to /tools/invoice after login.

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Login page ignores redirect query parameter
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In /app/frontend/app/login/page.tsx, the handleSubmit function on line 23 hardcodes router.push('/account') instead of reading the redirect parameter from URL search params
rca_of_the_issue.fix_suggestion: Use useSearchParams() hook to read redirect parameter and use it in router.push(). Example: const searchParams = useSearchParams(); const redirect = searchParams.get('redirect') || '/account'; router.push(redirect);
